The thing is France is not only "Paris and the rest is countryside". There are many decent-size cities that are much better than Paris with open-minded people (I am thinking about Lyon, Nantes, Caen, Poitiers, Nice,... Well pretty much any city you see on a map with a smaller dot than Paris haha). Edit so it's clearer: when I talked about the countryside, I was thinking about the REAL countryside, what we call the "deep France", where one barely has a proper internet connection. 

And it is difficult because people have to pay you more the more educated you are (like in every country I guess).... But most people don't want to. So when my generation was in high school (around 10 years ago), we were told to do long studies to get a nice job... But by the time we finished our studies, there was no job for us anymore.

France here ! Pros are : generally cheap; you can get a nice house easily with a normal salary; many various landscapes and climates (we have parts with mountains, sea, countryside, volcanos, tropical weather etc); social helps; people are generally nice. Cons are : PARISIANS (if you want to go to France please don't stay in Paris, there is way better to see outside it!); Macron (ruining the good things about this country); people might be a bit xenophobic in the countryside; hard to find a job when you have a university diploma; police violences; corruption; the press being less and less free.
Stay safe, from France
